business_summary: Nakayama Steel Works, Ltd. engages in the steel, engineering, building materials, and real estate businesses in Japan. It offers steel coil products, including hot, pickled, plated, slit, and striped /pattern coils; and steel plate products, such as thick steel and NP steel plates, leveling sheets, checker plate, and pattern steel sheet, as well as hot rolled steel products. The company also provides bars and wire rod products comprising steel bars, burn-in- coils, and wire rods, as well as lightweight C-shaped steel, pipes, wire rod secondary products, steel billets, and by-products. In addition, it offers steel artificial reefs, breeding reefs, and floating artificial reef recovery; and casting machine engineering products, including rolls, valves, and casting and processing equipment. Further, it engages in manufacturing and processing of lightweight shaped steel sections, electric resistance welded steel pipes, and construction-related products; buying, leasing, brokerage, and sale of real estate properties; and port transportation and freight vehicle transportation businesses. The company provides general shipping and shipping brokerage services; and environmental services. The company was incorporated in 1923 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Nakayama Steel Works, Ltd.는 일본에서 철강, 엔지니어링, 건축자재, 부동산 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 그것은 뜨거운, 절인, 도금, 슬릿 및 줄무늬 / 패턴 코일을 포함한 강철 코일 제품을 제공합니다. 후판, NP강판, 레벨링시트, 체커판, 패턴강판 등의 후판제품과 열연강판 제품을 생산하고 있습니다. 또한, 봉강, 번인코일, 선재 등으로 구성된 봉강 제품과 경량 C형강, 파이프, 선재 2차제품, 철강 빌렛, 부산물 등을 공급하고 있습니다. 또한 강철 인공 암초, 번식 암초 및 부유식 인공 암초 복구를 제공합니다. 롤, 밸브, 주조 및 가공 장비를 포함한 주조 기계 엔지니어링 제품. 또한, 경량형강 형강, 전기저항 용접강관, 건축 관련 제품의 제조 및 가공업을 영위하고 있습니다. 부동산 구매, 임대, 중개 및 판매; 항만운송업, 화물자동차운송업 등이 있다. 회사는 일반 운송 및 운송 중개 서비스를 제공합니다. 환경 서비스. 목
